name: com.supastro/astrology
title: Supastro
description: Vedic astrology calculations: birth charts, dashas, transits, yogas, compatibility and panchang

tools.name: cast_birth_chart
tools.description: Calculates a Vedic (sidereal, Lahiri) birth chart from a birth date, clock time and place: the rising sign (Lagna), and for each of the nine planets its sign, whole-sign house, degree, nakshatra and pada, plus the Moon's nakshatra. Use it when someone asks for their kundli, rising sign, Moon sign, nakshatra or planet placements. Returns calculated positions only, with no interpretation. The rising sign changes about every two hours, so an exact birth time matters.

birth_date.description: Date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 1990-01-15 for 15 January 1990. People write dates in different orders: day first in India and most countries, month first in the United States. Convert what the person wrote to YYYY-MM-DD yourself. If an all-number date could be read two ways, such as 05-06-1990, ask which number is the day before calling; never assume.

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth at the birth place, 24-hour HH:MM, for example 10:30, or 16:26 for 4:26 PM. If the person gave an hour from 1 to 12 without AM or PM, ask which before calling. Ask the user if the time is unknown; do not guess it.

birth_place.description: City and country of birth, for example "Mumbai, India".

latitude.description: Optional. Latitude of the birth place in decimal degrees, north positive. Give it only together with longitude, when the user supplied coordinates or the place could not be found by name.

longitude.description: Optional. Longitude of the birth place in decimal degrees, east positive. Give it only together with latitude.

tools.name: get_current_dasha
tools.description: Calculates which Vimshottari dasha periods are running for a birth: the Mahadasha, Antardasha and Pratyantardasha lords with each period's start and end date. Use it when someone asks which dasha or planetary period they are in, or when it ends. Covers today by default, or another date after the birth. Returns period lords and dates only, with no interpretation. The dates move with the birth time.

tools.name: get_panchang

Use it when someone asks for today's panchang, tithi, nakshatra, Rahu Kaal or sunrise for a place. Times are in the city's own time zone. Covers today by default, or another date.

tools.description: Calculates where the nine Vedic planets are right now in the sidereal zodiac (Lahiri): each planet's sign, degree, nakshatra and pada, whether it is retrograde, and when it next changes sign. Use it when someone asks where a planet is today, which planets are retrograde, or when a planet changes sign. Needs no birth details. Returns positions and dates only, with no interpretation.

Use it when someone asks whether today is a good day for them, for their Tara Bala or Chandra Bala, or when their Chandrashtama falls. Returns the computed positions with the classical rule's own result for each. Covers this moment by default, or another date.

It opens with a count of the yogas in each status. Use it when someone asks which yogas they have, whether a named yoga is in their chart, or when a yoga was or becomes active. Also lists yogas that are formed but dormant, with the reason and no dates.

tools.description: Finds auspicious date-and-time windows in the coming weeks for an activity in a city: a wedding or engagement, house-warming, business launch, travel, signing, buying property or a vehicle, a job start, starting studies, or a medical procedure. With birth details it also applies the person's Tara Bala and Chandra Bala. Use it when someone asks for a good date or time to do something. A wedding, house-warming or vehicle window also respects the season rules of the muhurat calendar.

tools.name: get_eclipses
tools.description: Calculates the solar and lunar eclipses of a year against a birth chart: each eclipse's date and type, the sidereal sign and nakshatra it falls in, the house it falls in counted from the rising sign and from the birth Moon, and the traditional reading of that count from the Moon sign. For a place it also says whether the eclipse is visible there, the local times of each contact and the Sutak window. Use it when someone asks about upcoming eclipses (grahan), whether one is visible where they live, its Sutak times, or where an eclipse falls in their chart.

birth_date.description: Date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 1990-01-15 for 15 January 1990. People write dates in different orders: day first in India and most countries, month first in the United States. Convert what the person wrote to YYYY-MM-DD yourself. If an all-number date could be read two ways, such as 05-06-1990, ask which number is the day before calling; never assume.

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth at the birth place, 24-hour HH:MM, for example 10:30, or 16:26 for 4:26 PM. If the person gave an hour from 1 to 12 without AM or PM, ask which before calling. Ask the user if the time is unknown; do not guess it.

birth_place.description: City and country of birth, for example "Mumbai, India".

latitude.description: Optional. Latitude of the birth place in decimal degrees, north positive. Give it only together with longitude, when the user supplied coordinates or the place could not be found by name.

longitude.description: Optional. Longitude of the birth place in decimal degrees, east positive. Give it only together with latitude.

year.description: Optional. The calendar year, from last year to ten years ahead. Defaults to this year.

viewing_place.description: Optional. City and country to check visibility and local times for. Defaults to the birth place.

viewing_latitude.description: Optional. Latitude of the viewing place. Only together with viewing_longitude.

viewing_longitude.description: Optional. Longitude of the viewing place. Only together with viewing_latitude.

tools.name: check_birth_time_sensitivity
tools.description: Shows how sensitive a birth chart is to its birth time. It gives the exact clock window in which the rising sign held on the birth day and how far the stated time is from a change, then recalculates the chart for earlier and later birth times and lists what changes: the rising sign, the Navamsa rising sign, the Moon's nakshatra and pada, the Atmakaraka and the dates of the Vimshottari periods. Use it when someone is unsure of their exact birth time, asks whether a few minutes would change their chart, or wants to know which parts of their chart are safe to rely on.

tools.name: compare_two_charts
tools.description: Reads two birth charts together across eight layers: the two birth charts (D1), the Navamsa (D9), Jaimini factors (Upapada, A7, Darakaraka), Ashtakavarga, both Manglik checks with their cancellations, dasha timing, the chart-to-chart planet links, and the 36-point Ashtakoota table as one layer among them. It returns a score for each layer with the findings behind it, the overall score and verdict band, Nadi and Bhakoot dosha with any cancellation, and the periods in which both people's relationship planets are active together. Use it when someone asks about compatibility, kundli matching or gun milan between two people. Both people's birth date, time and place are needed.

tools.name: read_life_area
tools.description: Calculates, in one answer, every layer of a birth chart that a question about one area of life rests on: career, money, marriage or relationship, children, property and home, education, spiritual path, the chart as a whole, or timing. It returns the birth chart with each planet's degree, nakshatra, dignity, retrogression and combustion; the area's houses with their lords, occupants and aspects; Ashtakavarga, Shadbala and Vimshopaka strength; the natural and Jaimini karakas; the Navamsa, the area's own divisional chart and each planet's Shashtiamsha (D60) portion; Bhava Chalit; the twelve Arudha padas including the Darapada (A7) and the Upapada; every special lagna; the yogas and doshas with their status; the four running dasha levels with dates and the periods ahead; and today's transits from the Lagna and the Moon. Use it when someone asks a real question about their life, such as how their career or marriage looks, when something may happen, or what their chart says overall. Needs the birth date, time and place.

tools.name: get_divisional_charts
tools.description: Calculates the divisional charts of a birth chart: Hora (D2), Drekkana (D3), Chaturthamsha (D4), Saptamsha (D7), Navamsa (D9), Dashamsha (D10), Dwadashamsha (D12), Shodashamsha (D16), Vimshamsha (D20), Chaturvimshamsha (D24), Saptavimshamsha (D27), Trimshamsha (D30), Khavedamsha (D40), Akshavedamsha (D45), Shashtiamsha (D60). For each it gives the chart's own Lagna, every planet's sign and house, its dignity there, and whether it is vargottama; the Shashtiamsha is given by planet, as each planet's portion with its classical name. Use it when someone asks for their D10, D7, D2 or another varga, or which planets are vargottama in it. Needs the birth date, time and place.

tools.name: get_special_lagnas
tools.description: Calculates the special lagnas of a birth chart: Hora Lagna, Ghati Lagna, Bhava Lagna, Pranapada Lagna, Indu Lagna, Sree Lagna, Varnada Lagna, Karakamsa, Surya Lagna and Chandra Lagna. For each it gives the sign, the degree where one is defined, the house from the birth-chart Lagna, how it is found, and for the time-driven ones how many minutes of birth-time error would move it. Use it when someone asks for one of these lagnas by name. Needs the birth date, time and place.
